problem_title: Conjectured coefficients in the transfer-matrix expansion for Camassa–Holm peakons

evidence.text:
We give a universal factorial formula for every partition coefficient in every positive trace power of the source generalized peakon Lax matrix, for all particle numbers. A curve-conditioned rank-two determinant collapse and the formal trace-log identity prove the formula and both printed families.
